title: [CH] When posting with FCY, VAT G/L Entry stores VAT base amount in Source Currency Amount instead of VAT amount
summary: When posting transactions with foreign currency, VAT G/L entries now correctly store the VAT amount in Source Currency Amount instead of the VAT base amount.
key_points: VAT G/L entries during foreign currency posting now use correct source currency amounts
Fixes incorrect storage of VAT base amount instead of VAT amount in Source Currency Amount field
Changes initialization logic in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line to avoid recalculating source currency amounts
Test coverage added to verify the correct behavior with foreign currency VAT posting
